EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 1
EPISODE LOGLINE: A stowaway hides aboard the last ferry of the night, and the captain finds a ledger that should not exist.
CONTINUITY NOTES: First episode. Introduces Mara, Captain Oda, and the purser.

--- SCRIPT START ---
